title: egress gate fails open on sub-IPv6-header datagrams
description: gateway.rs egress_tunnel_authorized returned true for received.ipv6.len()<40, forwarding malformed datagrams upstream without tunnel authorization — contradicts the gate's fail-closed contract (spec 06-security 8.11). Fixed to drop + warn; found by reviewer pass 2/3 on m9i4.
close_reason: Fixed: egress_tunnel_authorized now drops sub-40-byte datagrams with warn (fail-closed). Reviewer re-review PASS (pass4). Reviewed under m9i4 3x codereview; correctness pass 1 also PASS.
